summary: The note is a Wikipedia-style entry describing Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, a city in the northeastern part of the state, mainly in Tulsa County with a small western section in Wagoner County. It is the largest suburb of Tulsa and part of the Tulsa Metropolitan Area. The entry gives population figures from the 2010 census and a July 2017 estimate.
one_line: Broken Arrow is a city in northeastern Oklahoma and the largest suburb of Tulsa, with population figures from the 2010 census and a 2017 estimate.
key_facts: Broken Arrow is a city located in the northeastern part of the U.S. state of Oklahoma.
Broken Arrow is primarily located in Tulsa County.
A section of Broken Arrow is located in western Wagoner County.
Broken Arrow is the largest suburb of Tulsa.
According to the 2010 census, Broken Arrow has a population of 98,850 residents.
According to the 2010 census, Broken Arrow is the fourth-largest city in Oklahoma.
A July 2017 estimate reports that the population of Broken Arrow is just under 112,000.
The July 2017 estimate ranks Broken Arrow as the 280th-largest city in the United States.
Broken Arrow is part of the Tulsa Metropolitan Area.
The Tulsa Metropolitan Area has a population of 961,561 residents.
